method: Review the MCP Security Best Practices SSRF section and execute source-bound local verifiers for the lesson text and runnable Python examples.
limitations: This pass clarifies trust boundaries but is not a security certification.
Historical prompt-injection results, real OAuth/HTTP behavior, production egress policy, and sandbox isolation were not tested.
The first-load browser console reported only the existing /favicon.ico 404; the page had no horizontal overflow and the Mermaid chart rendered in both theme screenshots.
